verdict.rationale: Stripe Identity processes sensitive ID and biometric data, so whether that data can be excluded from AI or model training is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack never mentions training-data use, an opt-out, or data-retention controls tied to model training. Community worries about trusting Stripe with ID data do not address training use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
